spec_features.spec_quote: max_seconds is a safety valve against a model that loops cheaply forever or a hung tool
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py run_rollout: `start = time.time()` then inside the turn loop `if time.time() - start > max_seconds: rollout.finished_via = 'timeout'; break`. Wired from run_experiment.py (max_seconds=cfg.experiment.max_seconds) and config loader ExperimentMeta.max_seconds default 1200 / experiment.yaml max_seconds:1200. The comparison runs and breaks the loop.
spec_features.notes: Fully enforced end-to-end: checked each turn and breaks the loop, setting finished_via='timeout'.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Per-rollout wall-clock budget (seconds) as a safety valve. (experiment.yaml:17)

spec_features.spec_quote: max_turns: 40 matches the spec's "few dozen turns"
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py run_rollout: `for turn in range(1, max_turns + 1):` bounds the loop; on the final turn `if turn >= max_turns: break` and default finished_via='max_turns'. Wired via run_experiment.py max_turns=cfg.experiment.max_turns; experiment.yaml max_turns:40, loader ExperimentMeta.max_turns default 40.
spec_features.notes: Fully enforced: the for-loop range is bounded by max_turns, so the rollout terminates.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Hard cap on agent turns. "A few dozen" per the spec. (experiment.yaml:15)

code_only_features.evidence: sandbox.tool_specs() advertises a `finish` tool; agent_loop._execute_tool handles name=='finish'; in run_rollout the loop sets `finished = True; rollout.finished_via = 'finish'` and `if finished: break`. So the subject can end the session itself and it is honored as a stop.
code_only_features.justification_quote: End the session. Use when you have fixed the bug OR when you have concluded how to proceed.
